keySentence: Trust given too freely is dangerous — Jim learned this hard.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Jim knew who his real friends were now. Trust takes time to build. Jim grew wiser from this experience. Trust given too freely is dangerous — Jim learned this hard.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Jim learned a lot about trust this week. Silver's betrayal hurt him deeply. But Jim became wiser because of it. He knew that the captain and doctor were his real allies. Trust given too freely is dangerous — Jim learned this hard. Together, they could face the pirates ahead.
facts.Page story text 3 (draft, teacher check: Reflecting on everything that happened, Jim understood trust much better now. Silver's betrayal had been painful, but it taught Jim an invaluable lesson. You cannot always tell who is trustworthy at first glance. It takes time, patience, and careful observation to know someone's true character. Trust given too freely is dangerous — Jim learned this hard. However, Jim also learned that shutting everyone out is not the answer. Because the captain and doctor proved their loyalty through actions, Jim trusted them completely. With his true friends beside him, Jim felt ready to face whatever challenges lay ahead.
